name: 93101 · Santa Barbara, CA
findings: ZIP 93101 (Santa Barbara) has 340 nonprofit organizations. 145 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93101 (Santa Barbara) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93101 (Santa Barbara) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
